name: GUARANA
key_symptoms: Intellectual excitement. Sick headache in persons who have used tea and coffee in excess. Throbbing headache after use of liquor.
Bowels.--Stools profuse, bloody, bright green; flakes inter-mixed; odorless. Cholera infantum.

skin_symptoms: Chloasmata on temples and arms. Urticaria (Dulc; Apis; Chloral).
sleep_symptoms: Uncontrollable sleepiness and heaviness of head, with flushed face after eating.
